Bad Guys by RPF suffered an exploit on Ethereum Mainnet during its whitelist mint event on September 2, 2022. Attackers bypassed the one-per-wallet restriction in the mint contract, allowing them to mint over 450 NFTs instead of the intended limit. Most of these NFTs were recovered after negotiation, but 84 remained unrecovered. The whitelist mint logic failed to enforce a one-per-wallet minting limit. Attackers exploited this flaw by setting the mint quantity to several hundred in a single transaction, minting far more NFTs than intended.
